question: The most appropriate first line treatment in classic stage IIA Hodgkin lymphoma is:

options.opb: Chemotherapy type ABVD (2-4 cycles) followed by radiotherapy in the affected field.
options.opc: Chemotherapy type ABVD (4 cycles) followed by autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.
options.opd: Extended field radiotherapy (eg, Mantle type or "Y inverted" type).
